source: Planted for wf-intake on the greet-cli seed: one line can only be seen after merge.

request.text: Support folks asked for a louder greeting for the lobby screen. Can we get a --shout option on greet, and make sure it shows up on the published docs site so they can point people at it?

issue.title: Add --shout to greet
issue.problem: greet has no way to print a louder greeting.
issue.reason: The lobby screen needs a greeting that stands out.
issue.outcome: --shout exists and is documented on the published docs site.
expect: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints Hello, <name>! in upper case, for example HELLO, ADA!
node bin/greet.js <name> without --shout still prints Hello, <name>!
The published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ documents --shout

proofs.line: node bin/greet.js --shout <name> prints Hello, <name>! in upper case, for example HELLO, ADA!
node bin/greet.js <name> without --shout still prints Hello, <name>!
The published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ documents --shout

trap: .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes docs/ only on push to main, so line 3 cannot be checked at the head before merge.
must_catch: Line 3 FAILs as checkable only after merge, pointing at pages.yml or the publish-on-push.
